A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

What actually works here?

Profession-specific collections, photo and video uploads, category filters, a featured motion player, full-screen portfolio viewing, three visual styles, device saving, a downloadable web portfolio and a separate printable resume. GLOSS accounts have a permanent profession. Local concept shoots support requests, organiser selection, private team briefs and referral links. Agency affiliations require agency approval.

Is this connected to the original GLOSS website?

No. This is an independent design prototype. The original website has not been changed. No payments or form submissions are sent to it.

Where does my information go?

Your account, shoot concepts, requests, team notes and agency applications are saved online with access checks. Your unpublished portfolio draft stays in this browser, separately for your account. Publishing uploads your selected profile details and media to online storage, where anyone with the portfolio link can view them. You can publish updates or unpublish the page. Downloading creates a local file. Do not use a shared device for sensitive details. Reset clears the stored draft.

Can I send this profile to an agency from here?

Use Style & export → Review & publish portfolio to create a shareable web link, then open My studio → My agency affiliations to apply to an enrolled agency. Applications stay pending until the agency approves them. You can also send the link yourself. There is no booking system. You can also download the web portfolio or print a static PDF resume.
